en: Colorized historical postcard showing several cavalry soldiers and officers in different uniforms from various periods, some mounted on horses and others standing. The men wear elaborate dress uniforms with shakos, helmets, and plumed hats in red, blue, and white, representing different regiments and years. German text in red at the top references Grossenhain and the K. S. 1. Husaren-Regiment "König Albert" Nr. 18, with dates from 1734 to the present. At the bottom, red captions identify specific regiments and years, such as Ulan-Regt. Prinz Clemens 1815 and I. Hus.-Rgt. No. 18 1876. Additional German text appears along the left and right margins.
